purpose: Masala Short (draft): युद्ध से एक दिन पहले माँ ने बताया सच… कर्ण और कुंती 😢 | Mahabharat Emotional Story #shorts

scenes.scene: Wide shot at eye level showing the whole place. Setting: the bank of the river Ganga at dawn in ancient India, stone steps going down into the misty water, the sun rising over the river. What happens: Wide shot: the misty river Ganga at dawn, the sun rising over the water, empty stone ghat steps in the foreground, a few oil lamps floating on the water; no people, no hands, no body parts anywhere in the frame. Nobody speaks and nobody's lips move; no voices at all. There are no people, no faces and no heads anywhere in this shot, only what is described. Nobody looks into the camera lens: the camera is an invisible observer that nobody notices. Everyone is clearly Indian, with brown skin and Indian features, like real actors in an Indian TV serial; never cartoon, anime or plastic-looking. Film look: Photorealistic live-action epic Indian historical drama set in ancient India, shot on a cinema camera, golden dawn light, soft mist over the river, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field. Upright, normal orientation (never rotated or upside down). Vertical 9:16 frame for a phone screen, faces in the upper-middle of the picture. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no signboards, no shop signs, no posters, no name plates, no vehicle number plates, no readable letters anywhere.
scenes.sound: Gentle river water, soft temple bells far away, no voices, and an off-screen narrator's voice-over: a deep, warm Indian male storyteller's voice, speaking Hindi warmly and playfully, close to the microphone.

scenes.scene: Medium close-up of an Indian storyteller with a deep, warm Indian male storyteller's voice, sitting in a quiet dim room, looking at someone just off-screen, speaking clearly in Hindi with feeling, at a natural pace without long pauses, finishing the whole line by the sixth second. Voice: a deep, warm Indian male storyteller's voice. Only this one person, nobody else. Photorealistic.
scenes.dialogue: महाभारत युद्ध से एक दिन पहले… एक माँ अपने बेटे से मिलने आई।
scenes.sound: A quiet room, only the spoken voice, no music, no other sounds

checks.line: महाभारत युद्ध से एक दिन पहले… एक माँ अपने बेटे से मिलने आई।
